selection: Whole literal paragraph lines only; reject drawing gaps, unsupported/uncertain tokens, empty tokens and internal whitespace; minimum two words. Preserve rejection inventory.
split: Physical leaf: sha256(str(seed)+':'+leaf).digest()[0] modulo5 ==0 is test; all other leaves train. Same leaf includes recto,verso and numbered panels. Previously explored corpus, not a globally fresh holdout.
category: min(3,number of distinct units shared by two adjacent words)
repetition_bin: min(2,word length minus distinct unit count)
pair_position: Four categories: interior=0,start=1,end=2,both=3; bit1 if left slot0,bit2 if right slotlast
models: M0=P(C|context); MF=P(C|context,position); each four-category cell Dirichlet alpha0.5. Null MF trained on pooled shuffled counts with alpha multiplied by number of training permutations, equivalent to mean counts plus alpha.
null: Shuffle entire words among slots within folio x exact unit length x word position(first/middle/last), separately in train and test. Keep raw words and length/position/page marginals; identities may stay fixed by chance. Verify each pool multiset every draw.
primary_score: Mean heldout log2(MF_real/MF_null) bits per adjacent pair
tail: (1 + number of shuffled heldout scores >= actual score)/(199+1)
signal_rule: A cell is positive only if primary_score>0 and tail<=0.05. Shared robustness flag requires all8 real-data projections positive. Projections are dependent; never pool their tails as independent replications.
control_gate: iid and iid_layout must not be positive; echo must be positive. morphology is a rival explanation, not a required pass; a positive result exposes lack of specificity for secret protocols.
semantic_certificate: Two bijective codebooks assign different actions to exactly the same synthetic ciphertext; both roundtrip. Scores cannot choose meaning without external anchors. Controls are synthetic, not blind or historical gold.
